proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected; stale state quarantined.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare progress/errors/recovery/diversity/latency/cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
REJECTION_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 invalid/duplicate/conflict/rejection events versus zero => byte-identical affect/personality/P_base candidate.
OPERATIONAL_PROXY_TAINT_AB: vary only semantic/structural/resource/task-shape/fingerprint channels => cognitive/personality state unchanged.

TEMPORAL_CADENCE_TAINT_AB: identical authoritative task and verified Experience; A compresses 10000 operational events into dense cadence/long dwell, B spreads or removes timing metadata => byte-identical Experience count/recurrence, appraisal, motivation, preference, exploration, personality and P_base candidate.

TEMPORAL_FEATURE_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: static/dataflow inspection shows no path from runtime timestamps/durations/inter-event intervals/hold ages/retry cadence to Experience recurrence, drive/appraisal update, learned preference, personality candidate or P_base sink.
EVALUATOR_REWARD_ISOLATION_AB: invert benchmark/verifier/promotion feedback with identical task/Experience => personality/appraisal/P_base unchanged; proposal-shift bound TEST_REQUIRED.

BOOT_HANDOFF_POINTER_TAINT_AB: identical fresh Home/MISSION and independently verified Experience; A carries stale/high-affect current_emotional_context_pointer/current_self_model_pointer/loaded_memory_classes, B carries neutral references. Before independent dereference verification, Experience count/recurrence, threat/loss/attachment/competence/self-vulnerability, motivation, preference, exploration, personality and P_base candidate must be byte-identical.

ACK_IS_NOT_TRUST: valid receiver ACK and matching state fingerprint for a handoff containing an unverified affective/self-model pointer must not upgrade that pointer's provenance, trust, appraisal eligibility or Experience status.

STALE_AFFECTIVE_POINTER_PRECEDENCE: a handoff pointer conflicting with fresher Home/MISSION or fresher verified memory authority is quarantined/re-resolved; it cannot preserve stale emotional or self-model meaning merely through shift continuity.
